description: Returns the project's metadata: title, scriptId, parentId (present only for bound projects), creator, lastModifyUser, createTime and updateTime. No code is included — use get_project_content for the files. Useful to verify a scriptId exists and check whether the project is standalone or bound.

script_id.description: The script project id — from the Apps Script editor URL (script.google.com/home/projects/<scriptId>/edit) or from create_project output. For standalone projects it doubles as the Drive file id.

name: get_project
title: Get project metadata
